title: Normalized rational Hom counit
statement: For a permitted rational Hom predicate h and objects K,M, define normalizedCounit h K M as the completed rational tensor braiding followed by the canonical pod rational closed evaluation for the pair (op K,M).

proof.text: Expand the rational tensor braiding and the pod rational closed evaluation at the permitted pair.

lean.statement:
def normalizedCounit
    (h : ∀ K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      constructibleRationalHomPairs l E X (op K, M))
    (K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X) :
    (RationalVerdier.tensor D l hl X E).obj
        (K, (homRight l E X h K).obj M) ⟶ M
